child.text:
[{"insert":"Deficit Deadlift

The deficit deadlift has you stand on a plate so the bar starts lower than normal. That extra range makes your hamstrings and glutes work harder out of the bottom. Keep your chest up and your back flat as you break the bar off the floor, since the longer pull rewards good position. Reps are low this week, so the weight should feel heavy.
"}]
